free_tier_limits: Free unlimited API use (no call quotas or monthly fees). Free messaging subject to rate limits: ~1 msg/sec per private chat, 20 msg/min per group. Bulk free broadcast throughput and paid Stars broadcast rates are separate (see rate_limits).
rate_limits: FAQ: ~1 message/sec per private chat; ≤20 messages/min per group; 429 on excess. Free bulk broadcast about 30 msg/sec; paid broadcasts (BotFather/Stars) can go higher when eligible. Other method limits not fully published.
description: Official HTTP interface for Telegram bots: send and receive messages, media, keyboards, payments, Mini Apps, and updates via long polling or webhooks. Auth is a bot token from @BotFather placed in the request URL. The cloud API is free of charge; messaging is rate-limited, with optional paid higher-throughput broadcasts via Telegram Stars where offered.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: partial correct—keep free API + private/group FAQ limits; drop treating ~30/sec and paid Stars as free-tier (FAQ https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq). rate_limits: keep FAQ private/group + 429; bulk ~30/sec and paid broadcast are real but document as broadcast tiers not pure free-tier (FAQ + BotFather). description: softens paid Stars throughput claim while keeping free API + token-in-URL + long poll/webhook (https://core.telegram.org/bots/api, https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq).
